tables.name: Leads
tables.description: Main CRM table tracking all leads through the full pipeline

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Full name of the lead

fields.name: Email
fields.description: Business email address (primary key for deduplication)

fields.name: Company
fields.description: Company/Organization name

fields.name: Title
fields.description: Job title / position

fields.name: Industry
fields.description: Industry from Apollo

fields.name: Website
fields.description: Company website URL

fields.name: LinkedIn_URL
fields.description: LinkedIn profile URL

fields.name: Country
fields.description: Country/Location of lead

fields.name: Apollo_ID
fields.description: Apollo.io unique person ID - used for deduplication

fields.name: AI_Score
fields.description: AI-generated fit score 1-10. Leads below 7 are auto-filtered.

fields.name: AI_Score_Reasoning
fields.description: AI explanation of why this lead received this score

fields.name: AI_Fit_Factors
fields.description: Key factors that make this lead a good fit (comma-separated)

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Current pipeline status of the lead

choices.name: Pending Review
choices.description: AI scored >= 7, waiting for human approval in Airtable

choices.name: Approved
choices.description: Approved by human - WF2 will pick up and send email

choices.name: Rejected
choices.description: Rejected by human - will not receive any email

choices.name: Email Sent
choices.description: Initial email sent - WF3 will handle follow-ups

choices.name: Follow-up 1 Sent
choices.description: First follow-up sent (3 days after initial)

choices.name: Follow-up 2 Sent
choices.description: Second follow-up sent (5 days after first follow-up)

choices.name: Follow-up 3 Sent
choices.description: Third and final follow-up sent (7 days after second)

choices.name: Replied - Interested
choices.description: Lead replied and expressed interest - TAKE ACTION NOW

choices.name: Replied - Wrong Person
choices.description: Replied saying wrong contact - find right person

choices.name: Replied - On Leave
choices.description: Auto-reply or on leave - will follow up again after return

fields.name: Email_Subject
fields.description: Subject line of the initial email sent

fields.name: Email_Thread_ID
fields.description: Gmail thread ID for reply tracking and sending follow-ups in same thread

fields.name: Email_Sent_Date
fields.description: Date when the initial email was sent

fields.name: Last_Email_Date
fields.description: Date when the most recent email (initial or follow-up) was sent

fields.name: Follow_up_Count
fields.description: Number of follow-up emails sent (max 3)

fields.name: Reply_Intent
fields.description: AI-classified intent of the reply email

fields.name: Reply_Summary
fields.description: AI-generated Vietnamese summary of what the reply said

fields.name: Last_Reply_Content
fields.description: First 500 characters of the most recent reply email body

fields.name: Reply_Date
fields.description: Date when the lead replied

fields.name: Notes
fields.description: Manual notes from sales team

fields.name: Created_Date
fields.description: Date when this record was created (lead discovered)

views.name: 📋 All Leads
views.description: All leads sorted by AI score

views.name: ✅ Approved Queue
views.description: Approved leads ready for email sending

views.name: 📧 Active Campaign
views.description: Leads currently in the email sequence

views.name: 🔥 Interested - Act Now!
views.description: HOT leads who replied with interest

views.name: 📊 Pipeline Overview
views.description: Kanban view of all leads by status
